class.name: VideoEffectSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [VideoEffectSettingsServer]: effect quality and environment overrides.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"video_effect"[/code]. [VideoEffectSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/video_effect.ini[/code]. Change the values through the methods of [VideoEffectSettingsServer] or [method SettingsServer.set_value], not on the resource, so that they are validated and applied. The setters store values as they are; [VideoEffectSettingsServer] clamps values out of range and replaces invalid enum values with the default, with a warning, when they are set or loaded. Values the current renderer ignores are stored too, so that the same file works with every renderer. It can also be used as the project defaults of the domain: save a [VideoEffectSettings] as a [code].tres[/code] file and name it in the project setting [code]settings/defaults/video_effect[/code].

members.member: If [code]false[/code], fog is turned off in every environment ([constant RenderingServer.ENV_EFFECT_FOG]); [code]true[/code] restores [member Environment.fog_enabled]. Turning fog off can reveal geometry the level hides in the fog. Every renderer.

If [code]false[/code], glow is turned off in every environment ([method RenderingServer.environment_set_global_effect_disabled] with [constant RenderingServer.ENV_EFFECT_GLOW]). The environments keep their [member Environment.glow_enabled]; [code]true[/code] restores it. Every renderer.

If [code]false[/code], screen-space ambient occlusion is turned off in every environment ([constant RenderingServer.ENV_EFFECT_SSAO]); [code]true[/code] restores [member Environment.ssao_enabled]. Forward+ only.

If [code]false[/code], screen-space indirect lighting is turned off in every environment ([constant RenderingServer.ENV_EFFECT_SSIL]); [code]true[/code] restores [member Environment.ssil_enabled]. Forward+ only.

If [code]false[/code], screen-space reflections are turned off in every environment ([constant RenderingServer.ENV_EFFECT_SSR]); [code]true[/code] restores [member Environment.ssr_enabled]. Forward+ only.

If [code]false[/code], volumetric fog is turned off in every environment ([constant RenderingServer.ENV_EFFECT_VOLUMETRIC_FOG]); [code]true[/code] restores [member Environment.volumetric_fog_enabled]. Forward+ only.

Multiplies [member Environment.adjustment_brightness] of every environment ([method RenderingServer.environment_set_global_adjustment]). An environment without adjustments counts as [code]1.0[/code]. Range [code]0.01[/code] to [code]8.0[/code]. Every renderer.
Multiplies [member Environment.adjustment_contrast] of every environment. Range [code]0.01[/code] to [code]8.0[/code]. Every renderer.

The quality of the depth of field blur, pushed with [method RenderingServer.camera_attributes_set_dof_blur_quality]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/camera/depth_of_field/depth_of_field_bokeh_quality]. Forward+ and Mobile.

The bokeh shape of the depth of field blur, pushed with [method RenderingServer.camera_attributes_set_dof_blur_bokeh_shape]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/camera/depth_of_field/depth_of_field_bokeh_shape]. Forward+ and Mobile.

If [code]true[/code], the depth of field samples are jittered: smoother with fewer samples, needs TAA to hide the noise. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/camera/depth_of_field/depth_of_field_use_jitter]. Forward+ and Mobile.
Multiplies [member Environment.adjustment_saturation] of every environment. Range [code]0.01[/code] to [code]8.0[/code]. Every renderer.

The number of frames SDFGI takes to converge, pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_sdfgi_frames_to_converge]. Fewer frames react faster and look noisier. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/global_illumination/sdfgi/frames_to_converge]. Forward+ only.

The number of frames over which SDFGI spreads the update of dynamic lights, pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_sdfgi_frames_to_update_light]. More frames are faster and react later. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/global_illumination/sdfgi/frames_to_update_lights]. Forward+ only.

The number of rays per SDFGI probe and frame, pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_sdfgi_ray_count]. More rays are smoother and slower. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/global_illumination/sdfgi/probe_ray_count]. Forward+ only.

The quality target of [constant RenderingServer.ENV_SSAO_QUALITY_ULTRA], from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssao/adaptive_target]. Forward+ only.
The number of SSAO blur passes ([code]0[/code] to [code]6[/code]). More passes are smoother and slower. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssao/blur_passes]. Forward+ only.
The distance in meters where SSAO starts to fade out. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssao/fadeout_from]. Forward+ only.
The distance in meters where SSAO has faded out completely. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssao/fadeout_to]. Forward+ only.
If [code]true[/code], SSAO is rendered at half resolution: much faster, a bit blurrier. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssao/half_size]. Forward+ only.

The quality of screen-space ambient occlusion, pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_ssao_quality]. Higher is slower. [constant RenderingServer.ENV_SSAO_QUALITY_ULTRA] uses [member ssao_adaptive_target]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssao/quality]. Forward+ only.

The quality target of [constant RenderingServer.ENV_SSIL_QUALITY_ULTRA], from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssil/adaptive_target]. Forward+ only.
The number of SSIL blur passes ([code]0[/code] to [code]6[/code]). Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssil/blur_passes]. Forward+ only.
The distance in meters where SSIL starts to fade out. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssil/fadeout_from]. Forward+ only.
The distance in meters where SSIL has faded out completely. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssil/fadeout_to]. Forward+ only.
If [code]true[/code], SSIL is rendered at half resolution. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssil/half_size]. Forward+ only.

The quality of screen-space indirect lighting, pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_ssil_quality]. Higher is slower. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/ssil/quality]. Forward+ only.
The depth scale of subsurface scattering. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/subsurface_scattering/subsurface_scattering_depth_scale]. Forward+ only.

The quality of subsurface scattering, pushed with [method RenderingServer.sub_surface_scattering_set_quality]. [constant RenderingServer.SUB_SURFACE_SCATTERING_QUALITY_DISABLED] turns it off. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/subsurface_scattering/subsurface_scattering_quality]. Forward+ only.

The screen-space scale of subsurface scattering, pushed with [method RenderingServer.sub_surface_scattering_set_scale]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/subsurface_scattering/subsurface_scattering_scale]. Forward+ only.

If [code]true[/code], the volumetric fog is blurred to hide the froxel structure, pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_volumetric_fog_filter_active]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/volumetric_fog/use_filter]. Forward+ only.
The depth of the volumetric fog froxel buffer ([code]16[/code] to [code]512[/code]). Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/volumetric_fog/volume_depth]. Forward+ only.

The width and height of the volumetric fog froxel buffer ([code]16[/code] to [code]512[/code]), pushed with [method RenderingServer.environment_set_volumetric_fog_volume_size]. Higher is sharper and much slower. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/environment/volumetric_fog/volume_size]. Forward+ only.

The quality of [VoxelGI] (number of cones), pushed with [method RenderingServer.voxel_gi_set_quality]. Default: [member ProjectSettings.rendering/global_illumination/voxel_gi/quality]. Forward+ and Mobile.
